name: pi-tool-display
notes: Forked from MasuRii/pi-tool-display. The bashCommandDisplay contract lives in openspec (spec bash-command-display); bashLivePreviewMode and bashOutputMode:'auto' are documented in the package README. The read-only tool presentation provider (getToolPresentation/presentationRevision on pi-tool-display.api.v1) is specified in openspec (spec transcript-builder-api, change align-btw-transcript-presentation) and documented for consumers in docs/tool-presentation-provider.md with types in tool-display-api-consumer.d.ts.
reapplyOnSync: Preserve the package.json prepack/dist-pkg and bundled private diff dependency so independent installs resolve compiled JS without a registry copy.

Retain the esbuild dev dependency and call fork/stage-package.mjs from prepack so the packed Pi entry is a single .ts module with host peers and the bundled shared diff left external; the checkout still uses the source entry.

Reapply src/diff-renderer.ts delegation for split row pairing, column measurement and row composition to @xzzpig/pi-components/diff; preserve upstream file parsing, cell/ANSI rendering and user config. Retain the shared diff dependency in package.json and its independent bundled delivery.

the fork import block in src/bash-display.ts, where renderBashCall gains an optional config param, replaces upstream's new Text("", 0, 0) reuse expression with new BashCommandLineText("", 0, 0), and adds one resolveBashCommandDisplayArgs preprocessing line plus one text.setCollapse(shouldCollapseBashCommand(config, context)) line — buildBashCallText and its 3 call sites keep upstream bytes
the bash-auto-mode import plus its normalization call at the top of the fork-owned renderBashDisplayResult, and the 2 renderBashCall call sites passing the existing getConfig()
the types.ts / config-store.ts / config-modal.ts / presets.ts entries for bashOutputMode and bashCommandDisplay
the README mode/config rows, the live-preview paragraph, the 'Bash Command Line Display' section and example-config key, plus config/config.example.json
keep the kind:'bash' adapter and the renderBashDisplayResult extraction that let pi-sandbox's decorated bash tool render natively

the read-only presentation provider seams in src/tool-overrides.ts: the src/tool-presentation.ts import, the recordToolPresentation(pi, tool) call after a successful pi.registerTool in registerRuntimeTool, the attachToolPresentationApi(api, getConfig) call before the api.v1 global assignment, the bindToolPresentationOwner(pi, toolDisplayApi) call right after installToolDisplayApi, the localWorkspace guard at the top of resolvePendingDiffPreview, the executionMetadata gate around getWriteExecutionMeta in the write renderResult plus the same-branch content fallback that shows the real result text instead of an inferred empty-previous-file diff, and the disposeToolPresentationApi(toolDisplayApi) call in the registerToolDisplayOverrides cleanup
the optional getToolPresentation/presentationRevision members, the ToolPresentationSnapshot/render-context/display-capabilities types and the docs path reference in tool-display-api-consumer.d.ts
the docs/tool-presentation-provider.md entry in package.json files so the consumer contract ships in the tarball
keep the type-publishing build (rollup.dts.config.mjs, exports types -> dist/public.d.ts via prepack)
保留 tests/reload-behavior.test.ts 的配置隔离最小接缝：导入 createConfigReloadFixture，向 load/save 显式传同一个临时 configFile，并在 finally 调用 cleanup；保留原有断言，不备份或恢复包根及用户配置。
保留 fork 独立发布版本、FORK-CHANGELOG 发布条目与仓库 versions.json 的一致性；不要用 upstream 版本替换 fork 版本。

Keep pi.changelogPath pointing to ./FORK-CHANGELOG.md, ship the fork log and any upstream changelog, and retain README release-history navigation. Never append fork releases to the upstream log; follow docs/fork-changelogs.md.
doNotReintroduce: Do not restore a second tool-display-local copy of the split pairing/row-composition algorithms; both edit/write and Goal-X must use the shared diff implementation without changing existing tool-display output.
do not re-add the fork-only formatEarlierLinesHint/buildTailPreviewText copies or the unreachable empty-lines branch: upstream's optional label and take:'head'|'tail' params cover both
package-lock.json keeps upstream bytes at the upstream version across fork releases — do not hand-edit it
不要恢复 reload 测试对被忽略的包根 config.json 的依赖，也不要通过 CI 创建占位配置或跳过断言来掩盖干净 checkout 失败。
Do not mix fork release headings into the upstream changelog or use upstream history as the Pi startup changelog.

knownDebt.reason: [policy] The fork prebundles the installed extension entry to avoid per-module Jiti loading at startup; remove the prepack seam and build dependency when upstream ships an equivalent host-compatible prebuilt entry.

[policy] The fork consumes the private shared diff library so its renderer matches Goal-X and can be bundled independently; remove this dependency divergence when upstream supplies the same shared component and packaging.

[policy] Split pairing and row composition delegate to the shared diff library so tool and Goal-X rendering cannot drift; keep the upstream parser and tool-specific styling. Remove the seam when upstream exposes an equivalent reusable implementation accepted by both consumers.
[policy] Explicit fork changelog routing/packaging and dual-history navigation distinguish independent release sequences. Retain until upstream offers an equivalent fork-aware packaging contract.
